entry.title: New: dsh-perm-guard
entry.summary: Auto-approval permission guard: a middle tier between workspace-write and danger-full-access — auto-allows safe operations inside trust directories, always asks a human for destructive ones, with 11 per-category switches and an audit trail. Exact install spec: github:a903067276-rgb/dsh-perm-guard. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
